# USDA ARS (Agricultural Research Service)

> The USDA Agricultural Research Service conducts scientific research to advance agricultural productivity, food safety, nutrition, and sustainable farming practices.

ARS is the in-house research agency of the USDA, operating a network of research locations across the United States and internationally. The site provides access to research programs, publications, datasets, software tools, and scientific discoveries that address critical challenges in agriculture, food systems, and natural resource management.

## Key Topics

- Agricultural Research Service (ARS)
- National Programs
- Research Projects
- Scientific Discoveries
- Food Safety
- Pest Management
- Nutrition Research
- Sustainable Agriculture
- Office of International Research Engagement and Cooperation (OIREC)
- Office of Scientific Quality Review (OSQR)
- Publications & TEKTRAN
- Agricultural Datasets
- Research Software
- Animal Health
- Innovation

## Research Programs & Overview

- [ARS Home](https://www.ars.usda.gov): USDA ARS homepage showcasing agricultural research and innovations
- [About ARS](https://www.ars.usda.gov/about-ars): ARS organization overview, mission, vision, and leadership
- [Research Overview](https://www.ars.usda.gov/research): Main research overview with national programs and international engagement
- [National Programs](https://www.ars.usda.gov/research/programs): ARS national research programs covering nutrition, food safety, and agriculture

## Research Projects & Publications

- [Research Projects](https://www.ars.usda.gov/research/projects): Searchable database of USDA ARS research projects and initiatives
- [Find a Publication](https://www.ars.usda.gov/research/publications/find-a-publication): TEKTRAN publication search and scientific manuscript repository
- [Datasets](https://www.ars.usda.gov/research/datasets): Agricultural research datasets via Ag Data Commons repository
- [Software](https://www.ars.usda.gov/research/software): Catalog of downloadable agricultural research software tools

## Scientific Quality & International Research

- [Office of Scientific Quality Review](https://www.ars.usda.gov/office-of-scientific-quality-review-osqr): OSQR peer review and scientific quality evaluation for ARS research
- [Office of International Research Engagement and Cooperation](https://www.ars.usda.gov/office-of-international-research-engagement-and-cooperation/office-of-international-research-engagement-and-cooperation): OIREC international agricultural research partnerships and laboratories

## News & Scientific Discoveries

- [Scientific Discoveries 2025](https://scientificdiscoveries.ars.usda.gov): Annual highlights of ARS research impact on agriculture and consumers
- [News & Events](https://www.ars.usda.gov/news-events/news-events): ARS news, events, and multimedia content hub for research updates
- [5 Minutes Reads](https://scientificdiscoveries.ars.usda.gov/tellus): Quick-read articles on crop, pest, and food safety research
- [ARS Wired](https://www.ars.usda.gov/oc/ars-wired): ARS science communication with podcasts and social media content
- [Briefing Room](https://www.ars.usda.gov/oc/br/briefing-room): Research briefings on crop, pest, and animal health topics

## Public Engagement & Resources

- [Press Room](https://www.ars.usda.gov/oc/press-room): Press releases, media resources, and communications for journalists
- [Science in Your Shopping Cart - Factsheets](https://www.ars.usda.gov/oc/scienceinyourshoppingcart/siysc-factsheets): Science in Your Shopping Cart factsheets on agricultural products
- [Find A Location](https://www.ars.usda.gov/people-locations/find-a-location): Directory of ARS research locations and facilities by geographic area

## Optional

- [Archive - Monthly Discoveries](https://www.ars.usda.gov/oc/dof/archive): Archive of monthly agricultural discoveries and farming innovations
- [Archive - Scientist Interviews](https://www.ars.usda.gov/oc/utm/archive): Archive of scientist interviews and agricultural research articles
